subject: website
name: Winterlock
summary: Winterlock, a landing page for hash-based owners of Safe accounts, now with a Safe exposure check at /check/. Open source in johba37/winterlock.eth (no licence file seen); runs no third-party code and loads only its own files. It is not Level 4: the check sends the Safe address to RPC endpoints and Safe's Transaction Service, and nothing verifies their answers.

operations.name: Landing page and hash-chain demo
operations.note: Static HTML with self-hosted fonts and images; the demo runs in the browser and makes no request.

operations.name: Safe exposure check: read owners, threshold, modules, balances
operations.note: Reads chain state through a plain JSON-RPC endpoint with no light client, so the data is not verified.

operations.name: Safe exposure check: read confirmations from Transaction Service
operations.note: Reads signature history from Safe's backend API; the answer is trusted, not checked.

connections.name: Public JSON-RPC endpoints (publicnode, Base, Arbitrum, OP, Gnosis)
connections.note: Only after the user presses Check. The user can change the endpoint. The endpoint sees the Safe address and the visitor's IP.

connections.name: api.safe.global Transaction Service
connections.note: Only after the user presses Check, when an owner is a key with no transactions. A centralised API that sees the Safe address and IP.
